assessment.headline: DAY 39. 10 HOURS to deadline. Kharg Island struck. Sensex rallied +787. India is fully extracted.
assessment.body:
In 10 hours — at 5:30 AM IST Wednesday — Trump's deadline expires. He has already begun striking. Kharg Island, which handles 90% of Iran's oil exports, was hit today. Four bridges were struck: Kashan (railway, 2 killed), Karaj, Tabriz-Zanjan freeway, and Qom. 18 people were killed in Alborz province including 2 children. A container ship was struck in the Persian Gulf (UK military confirmed).

Trump's rhetoric reached its extreme: 'Whole civilization will die tonight.' 'The only one who sets a ceasefire is me.' Iran's response: 'We have 14 million ready to sacrifice.' An official urged youths to form 'human chains around power plants.' Iran threatened to strike an AI center in the UAE.

IRAN'S 10-POINT COUNTER (via Pakistan):
• Permanent end to war (not temporary ceasefire)
• Hormuz safe passage protocol
• Lifting of sanctions
• Reconstruction funding
• End to regional conflicts
• Guarantees against future attacks
• Iran retains 'permanent control' over Hormuz
• Possibility of 'tolls' as reparations

INDIA'S STRATEGIC POSITION IS STRONGEST IT HAS EVER BEEN:

• 8 of 9 Indian LPG tankers safely extracted — only Jag Vikram remains
• Sea Bird (Iranian LPG) discharged at Mangalore
• 10 Indian carriers total crossed Hormuz
• Government DOUBLED daily 5kg LPG quota for migrant labourers
• Oil India ramping up Rajasthan/Thar desert crude production
• 60 days crude stock. LPG 30+ days. 800 TMT cargoes secured
• Refineries at >100% utilization
• USA is now India's #1 LPG supplier (overtook UAE)
• India buying from USA + Russia + Iran + Australia simultaneously
• Petroleum Ministry: 51 lakh cylinders delivered Monday — ZERO shortages
• Jaishankar-Araghchi call today: 'India supports ongoing efforts to stop war'
• Qatar PM also called India in mediation efforts
• Indian basket ~$120
• Rupee ~93.0 vs USD (recovered)

MARKET REACTION TODAY:
• Sensex RALLIED +787 points to 74,107 (+1.07%) — biggest single-day gain in weeks
• But intraday crashed 1,378 points before recovering
• Nifty ~22,700. VIX at 26.19
• FII sold ₹8,167 Cr Monday. DIIs bought ₹8,000 Cr
• RBI rate decision tomorrow (expected steady at 5.25%)
• I&B Ministry extended TRP suspension on news channels for sensational war coverage

GLOBAL ESCALATION SIGNALS:
• Italy: 4 major airports in JET FUEL RATIONING until April 9 (Milan Linate, Bologna, Venice Marco Polo, Treviso)
• IEA head Birol: 'worse than 1973, 1979, and 2002 combined'
• Saudi Aramco hiked Asia oil price to RECORD premium
• Brent $111.63 intraday. WTI $115.64 intraday
• Container ship struck in Gulf
• Israeli Consulate Istanbul: gunbattle, 2 attackers dead
• OPEC+ adding 206 kbd in May

THE 10 HOURS AHEAD:
• 5:30 AM IST Wed = deadline expires
• Wed 7 AM = Indian market pre-open reacts
• Wed 9:15 AM = Sensex opens on the news

THREE SCENARIOS:
1. **DEAL ANNOUNCED** (25%): Brent crashes to $78, Sensex rallies past 83,000, rupee recovers to 91
2. **EXTENSION** (40%): Brent holds $108-112, Sensex flat volatile, continued uncertainty
3. **STRIKES ESCALATE** (35%): Brent spikes past $145, Sensex crashes to 55,000, rupee past 100

India's remarkable achievement: it enters this critical moment having already secured its energy supply chain, established diplomatic channels with all parties, and received the 8th LPG tanker home safely. Whatever happens in the next 10 hours, India has done everything within its power to prepare. The question now is what the rest of the world does.
